== Title ==
<span lang="ja">シスタヴァネン・ウルフマン</span>. Three asterisks precede the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">リアクションとして隣接する位置カードへ移動してよい。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ラック・シブラックはシスタヴァネン男性の典型といえる。凶暴だが攻撃的ではない。よく偵察兵として帝国アカデミーで訓練を受けているが、皇帝の勅令をいぶかしんでいる。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Shistavanen Wolfman]].

'''Lore''' — Lak Sivrak is typical of Shistavanen males. Ferocious, but not aggressive. Often trained as a scout at the Imperial Academy, but doubts the Emperor’s edict.

'''Game text''' — May move as a react to an adjacent location card.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore doubts 皇帝の勅令 rather than the New Order. Game text uses 位置カード for site. White border. CategoryOneGames Premiere 2PG Japanese catalog; the photograph crops the copyright year.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-shistavanenwolfman.gif|Original English face]], [[Shistavanen Wolfman]].</ref>
